  • RETRO LIFESTYLE SNEAKER — Inspired by iconic 1970s running shoes, the New Balance 327 blends retro design with a bold modern silhouette
  • SUEDE AND NYLON UPPER — Suede and nylon upper construction features an exaggerated fang design inspired by classic 320, 355, and Supercomp New Balance models

Product Description

The New Balance Women's 327 Lifestyle Sneaker reimagines 1970s running style with a bold, modern shape. Inspired by New Balance heritage models, this women’s sneaker features a suede and nylon upper with an exaggerated fang design, a flared midsole, and an oversized N logo for retro-inspired style. A lugged outsole draws inspiration from the 355 trail running shoe, while the rubber heel wrap, retro nylon tongue, spliteyerow, and medial New Balance text branding add distinctive finishing details. The result is a trendy lifestyle sneaker made for everyday outfits with unmistakable vintage influence.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    I'm on my feet 8-12 hrs/day and originally bought a pair for work. Truly helped ease my back, hip, knee & foot pain... to the point that on my days off (wearing what I thought were comfy shoes) the increased pain was quite noticeable. So, I got this second pair.

    The stability and comfort whether walking or standing long hours is great. I have narrow feet, ordered my usual size 9. Perfect, comfortable fit. Slip resistance is great. I was worried about the tread possibly peeling off the shoe since it wraps up the tie and heel but it seems secure so hopefully it won't be a problem. They seem very durable.

    It's a great value for the money although I waited for a deal to purchase this second pair.

About this Item

  • RETRO LIFESTYLE SNEAKER — Inspired by iconic 1970s running shoes, the New Balance 327 blends retro design with a bold modern silhouette
  • SUEDE AND NYLON UPPER — Suede and nylon upper construction features an exaggerated fang design inspired by classic 320, 355, and Supercomp New Balance models
  • LUGGED OUTSOLE — A lugged outsole inspired by the 355 trail running shoe adds heritage detail and everyday traction
  • DISTINCTIVE 327 DESIGN — A flared midsole, oversized N logo, and medial New Balance text branding create a standout, trendy look
  • RETRO FINISHING DETAILS — Rubber heel wrap, retro-inspired nylon tongue, and spliteyerow complete the vintage-inspired sneaker design

Product Description

The New Balance 327 takes inspiration from the most iconic running shoes of the 1970s and turns it into something bold and modern. These womens casual sneakers feature a synthetic and suede upper with an oversized N logo that gives them instant visual impact. The lugged rubber outsole is inspired by the 355 trail shoe, providing solid grip and durability for daily wear. A flared midsole and retro nylon tongue add authentic vintage character to these new balance 327 women, while the rubber heel wrap pulls design cues from classic New Balance models. These retro sneakers women pair well with everything from jeans and tees to dresses and skirts. If you want fashion sneakers women that blend throwback style with everyday comfort, the 327 delivers.
